_comment: Settings for sync_courses.py. `source` is the learn project's courses directory (a /teach workspace per course). Only lessons/ and reference/ are published -- MISSION.md, NOTES.md and learning-records/ are about the learner and stay private. `redact` is applied to every published page, in order, as regex -> replacement; `deny` is checked afterwards and any hit stops the sync, so a new lesson that mentions something personal can't slip out.
